note: Invented numbers for dashboard UI tests. Not real results.

rules: Make money on the 15 locked days that were kept hidden while the strategy was being designed.
Score at least 3.4 on the t-test over those days. With this many settings tried, a lower score could easily be luck.
Be profitable in at least 4 of the 5 time slices of the search period, not just one lucky stretch.
Make money on older archive data (April to August) that it was never tuned on, where that data exists.
Still make money when every order is placed one minute late, in case the bot is slow.
Beat the strategy already running live on the same coins over the same 15 days.

families.name: Fat-tail fair value
families.idea: Same idea as the live fair-value rule, but it assumes big sudden price jumps happen more often than a textbook bell curve says. That makes it less eager to bet against a coin that is far from its target.

families.name: Fair value, tight spreads only
families.idea: Only bets when the gap between the buy and sell price is small, so less of the edge is lost just getting into the trade.

families.name: Fair value with trend
families.idea: Adds the coin's direction over the last half hour to the fair-value estimate, on the theory that short moves tend to continue a little.

families.name: Night-shift fair value
families.idea: The fair-value rule, but only during Asian trading hours (7 PM to 3 AM US Eastern), when fewer traders keep these markets priced.

families.name: Bitcoin moves first
families.idea: When Bitcoin jumps, bet that smaller coins follow within a minute or two, before their markets catch up.

families.name: Last-minute sniping
families.idea: In the final two minutes, buy the side that is almost certain to win when it is still priced below 95 cents.

families.name: Order-book lean
families.idea: Bet in the direction of whichever side has more contracts waiting to be bought or sold.

families.name: Calm days only
families.idea: Trade only when the coin has been unusually calm, assuming the market overprices big moves on quiet days.

families.name: Snap-back after spikes
families.idea: After a sudden jump, bet that the price gives some of it back before the market closes.

families.name: Ride the last minute
families.idea: Bet that whatever the coin did in the last minute, it keeps doing until the close.

families.name: Fair value with limit orders
families.idea: The live rule, but posting a limit order at the bid instead of paying the asking price, to save about a cent per contract.

families.name: Opening mispricing
families.idea: In the first minute, bet against prices that look stale compared with where the coin is trading.
